answer: A work-anchored registry makes every identity pay a real, non-refundable cost: registering an agent means burning compute on a ferrous-hard puzzle tied to a public ridge of past attestations, so a fake swarm must redo that work for each copy. Like a reef built coral by coral, a legitimate reputation grows only through verified useful work over time, and an attacker buying a thousand shells still cannot fake the slow history honest agents carry.
